subject.title: [Bug]: OpenAI-compatible streaming tool calls are dropped when provider omits finish_reason

question: Should OpenClaw treat native OpenAI-compatible `delta.tool_calls` plus raw SSE `[DONE]`, without a final `finish_reason`, as a clean terminal signal that may execute tools?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but it changes a shipped fail-closed tool-execution boundary for custom provider output, so maintainer intent is needed before closing the issue or landing the linked fix.

options.title: Accept clean-DONE tool execution
options.body: Land the linked PR if maintainers accept native tool-call deltas plus raw SSE `[DONE]` as sufficient for tool execution without final `finish_reason`.

options.title: Require exact-provider proof
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until a redacted Evolink or equivalent live provider run proves the originally reported route after the fix.

options.title: Keep finish_reason required
options.body: Reject the linked PR and keep the current fail-closed behavior if explicit provider finish reasons remain mandatory for streamed tool execution.

recommendation.title: Accept clean-DONE tool execution
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR if maintainers accept native tool-call deltas plus raw SSE `[DONE]` as sufficient for tool execution without final `finish_reason`.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current stop-finished tool-call guard and documented the no-finish fail-closed behavior this issue asks to relax.
